hypotheses.justification: Compactness is only used as an argument to `abs_eigenvector_of_top_eigenvector`, and that lemma never uses it (its binder is `_hT_compact`). Its proof uses only self-adjointness, via `hT_sa.eq_smul_self_of_isLocalExtrOn`, which needs no compactness. It also uses positivity preservation and the top-eigenvalue bound. The rest of `eigenvector_constant_sign` uses only `ground_state_strictly_positive`, which has no compactness hypothesis. So the theorem is still true and provable with `hT_compact` deleted. The only change is to drop the `_hT_compact` argument from `abs_eigenvector_of_top_eigenvector` and from the call (or pass a dummy). No degenerate cases are involved.
